lexemes.pronunciationTip: Regional terms vary — amamma/avva are also heard.
Borrowed word, said with a Telugu accent.

sentences.translation: My elder brother's name is Ravi.
My elder sister is a doctor.
My younger sister goes to school.
There are four people at home.
I need coffee in the morning.
There is too much salt in the food.
I go to office on Monday.
There is a meeting on Thursday.
We'll go to a movie on Friday.
Everyone is at home on Sunday.
There is a tiger in the forest.
The fish is in the water.
There is a snake there, be careful!
